figures.caption: Figure 1: Audio attention proportion per layer under four conditions on Qwen2-Audio (MMAU-mini). Only instruction-based steering significantly increases the attention allocated to audio tokens, particularly in later layers.

Figure 2: Steering-induced attention change per audio token position of Qwen2-Audio, averaged across 48 samples from the controlled benchmark, with each sample containing a sequence of three exactly 5-second clips. Each row shows the attention delta when steering toward a different label. Attention increases (red) align with the corresponding clip position, confirming that instruction-based steering selectively redirects temporal focus.
